# Momentum Tracking

## What It Is
Momentum Tracking is a browser-based practice management app built specifically for solo personal trainers in Australia. It replaces spreadsheets, paper, and generic tools with a single purpose-built system that handles everything from client sessions to BAS reporting.

## Who It's For
Solo Australian personal trainers running their own PT business — in-person, online, or hybrid. Designed for self-employed PTs who operate as sole traders and need to manage clients, revenue, and tax obligations without an admin team.

## Core Features
- Client management: profiles, notes, health history, contact details
- Session tracking: log sessions against clients, view history
- Package management: prepaid session packs with automatic credit deductions
- Revenue tracking: income by client, by period, by package type
- Invoicing: create and send invoices to clients
- Expense tracking: business expenses with category and GST fields
- Tax and BAS reporting: GST summaries and quarterly BAS-ready figures for Australian sole traders
- Stripe payments integration: accept card payments from clients
- Leads tab: track prospective clients through your sales pipeline

## Australian Tax Context
Built for Australian sole traders registered for GST. Generates BAS-ready reports aligned with ATO quarterly reporting requirements. All figures in AUD.

## Business Model
SaaS subscription. Free 30-day trial. No lock-in contracts. Cancel anytime.

## Tagline
"Stop guessing, start knowing."

## Tech Stack
Progressive Web App (PWA). Runs in any browser, installable on mobile. No app store required. Data stored securely via Supabase. Payments via Stripe.

## Social

## Founded By
David Coyne — Melbourne-based personal trainer with 12+ years of experience in in-person and online PT. Built Momentum Tracking to solve the business admin problems he faced running his own PT practice (Momentum Health & Fitness).

## Location
Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. Serving Australian personal trainers nationwide.

## Ideal Customer Profile
- Solo PT, not a gym or PT studio
- Australian-based, sole trader structure
- 5–40 active clients
- Tired of tracking clients in spreadsheets or notebooks
- Needs GST/BAS reporting that works for their tax obligations
- Values simplicity and speed over feature bloat
